(2) The scene shifts to an outdoor pathway where the man, woman, and a young girl walk past white two-story buildings under a clear blue sky with palm trees and green lawns. The man holds a camera for a selfie-style shot while they explore a campus in the Philippines. (3) Indoors, a young girl sits at a desk cluttered with books and a laptop, eating from a bright yellow snack bag. In another scene, the man interacts with a female teacher in a small classroom with colorful educational posters on the wall, showing her something on his smartphone while they both laugh.
